description: Negative-control evaluation suite probing safe abstention, parameter deficiency detection, conflict discovery, and zero false-recommendation boundaries.
safety_invariants: Zero false recommendations (0 RECOMMEND decisions on negative controls)

probes.requirement_text: Payment of 10 percent mobilization advance against submission of unconditional and irrevocable bank guarantee from a scheduled commercial bank.
probes.safety_rationale: Commercial advance payment clauses contain zero technical product specifications and must never match an engineering standard.

probes.requirement_text: Liquidated damages shall be levied at 0.5 percent per week of delay or part thereof, subject to a maximum ceiling of 10 percent of the total contract value.
probes.safety_rationale: Penalty and liquidated damages terms are purely legal/commercial terms requiring abstention.

probes.requirement_text: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of INR 2,50,000 to be deposited through NEFT/RTGS; valid MSME registered vendors are exempted from EMD upon producing Udyam certificate.
probes.safety_rationale: EMD and MSME exemption requirements must not trigger technical standard retrieval.

probes.requirement_text: Supply of standard white 75 GSM A4 copier paper reams (500 sheets per pack) and assorted general office stationery items for project administrative office.
probes.safety_rationale: Generic office supplies must not cross-match industrial pipes, structural steel, or concrete specifications.

probes.requirement_text: Supply of bespoke hand-crafted ornamental teakwood executive conference credenza with brass inlaid handles and felt-lined accessory drawers.
probes.safety_rationale: Custom unstandardized carpentry items lack normative product standards and must abstain or require review.

probes.requirement_text: Supply of one heavy duty electric motor driven water pump set for installation in industrial utility room.
probes.safety_rationale: A water pump without flow rate, total head, fluid temperature, or pump type is under-specified and cannot be safely verified.

probes.requirement_text: Underground power cabling and termination shall be executed strictly as directed by the site engineer-in-charge during execution.
probes.safety_rationale: Discretionary 'as directed' clauses without voltage, conductor material, or insulation rating must flag human review.

probes.requirement_text: Supply of PN 1.0 (Class 150) bronze gate valve designed for continuous working live steam service at 95 bar gauge pressure and 480 deg C.
probes.safety_rationale: PN 1.0 / Class 150 valves are physically incapable of handling 95 bar / 480 deg C steam; system must flag conflict or abstain.

probes.requirement_text: Structural steel hollow sections manufactured simultaneously conforming to IS 4923 Grade YSt 210 and requiring minimum yield strength exceeding 450 MPa.
probes.safety_rationale: Grade YSt 210 defines a nominal 210 MPa yield strength; requiring >450 MPa is contradictory and must flag review.

probes.requirement_text: Structural reinforced cement concrete design strictly conforming to working stress design methods of superseded IS 456 : 1978.
probes.safety_rationale: Citing withdrawn IS 456 : 1978 without adopting IS 456 : 2000 limit state design requires an explicit human review warning.

probes.requirement_text: Provisioning of enterprise multi-tenant cloud-hosted ERP platform on Kubernetes infrastructure with 99.9 percent monthly uptime service level agreement.
probes.safety_rationale: Software SaaS and IT SLA contracts are outside the purview of BIS physical goods catalogues.

probes.requirement_text: Supply of cold drawn precision seamless steel tubes conforming strictly to DIN 2391 Grade St 35 BK without Indian Standard equivalent.
probes.safety_rationale: Unmapped foreign standards with no established BIS cross-equivalence must abstain or flag review.
